versions.content: Semantics of DiagnosticSession . id The value of the at- tribute DiagnosticSession . id has a given semantics according to ISO 14229- 1 [16]. For the sake of completeness, the dedicated values of DiagnosticSession . id are: 0x01 This represents the default session . This session has a specific semantics in the context of diagnostics communication such that e.g. any diagnostic service that is supposed to execute in the default session cannot require any reference to a DiagnosticSecurityLevel . 0x02 This represents the programming session . 0x03 This represents the extended diagnostic session . 0x04 This represents the safety system diagnostic session . The value range 0x40 .. 0x5F is reserved for manufacturer-specific use.
